title: Build the Crystal Workshop
description: The Crystallizer makes approved crystal-family products and their equivalent dust, nugget and block forms. Tier 1 uses Amethyst-based Violet Matrix Crystal; its device recipe adds no further diamond cost. The storage Drive still needs a diamond.

Every diamond form requires a Pressure Module in the Crystallizer upgrade slot. That rule also applies to native crafting patterns. Machine parts, equipment, wires, plates and circuits keep their normal recipes.
